1.1: From the elder: To the chosen lady and her kids—I love y'all for real, and not just me, but everybody who know the truth loves you too.
1.2: 'Cause that same truth lives in us and gon' stay with us forever.
1.3: Grace, mercy, and peace comin' your way—from God the Father and Jesus Christ, the Son. And it's all wrapped in truth and love. 💌
1.4: I was real glad when I saw some of your kids walkin' in the truth, just like the Father told us to.
1.5: Now sis, I ain't givin' you no new word—but the same one we had from the jump: that we love one another.
1.6: And love? It means walkin' in what He told us to do. This the command y'all heard from the beginning: live it out.
1.7: There's a whole bunch of deceivers out here now—folks who won't admit that Jesus came in the flesh. That's how you know it's Antichrist spirit.
1.8: So watch yourselves—don't lose what we been building. Stay on point, so you get your full reward. 🛡️
1.9: Anybody who steps outside Christ's teaching and don't stay in it? They ain't got God. But if you stay in the doctrine of Christ, you got both the Father and the Son.
1.10: If somebody come around you and they ain't bringin' that true doctrine, don't let 'em in your house and don't even greet 'em.
1.11: 'Cause if you do, you takin' part in their mess. You co-signin' evil. 👎🏾
1.12: I got a whole lot more I wanna say, but I ain't tryna write it out. I'm hopin' to pull up and talk to you face to face—so our joy can be complete. 😁
1.13: Your chosen sister's kids send they love too. Amen.
